source.text: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסָל־לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי־לֻוחֹ֤תאֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ׃

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that said Yahweh to me, cut for yourself two tablets of stones like the first [ones], and come up to me to the mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood,

en.L: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Cut for yourself two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and come up to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood,
en.B: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Cut two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the mountain, and make a wooden ark for yourself,
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Cut two flat stones like the first ones. Come up the mountain to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Also make an ark, a wooden chest.

es.L: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Lábrate dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y sube a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} al monte, y hazte un arca de madera,
es.B: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Corta dos tablas de piedra iguales a las primeras y sube al monte a encontrarte conmigo; hazte también un arca de madera,
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Corta dos piedras planas como las primeras. Sube al monte donde estoy yo. Haz también un arca, es decir, un cofre de madera.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Taille-toi deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et monte vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur la montagne, et fais-toi une arche de bois,
fr.B: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Taille deux tables de pierre semblables aux premières et monte vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur la montagne ; fabrique-toi aussi une arche en bois,
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Taille deux pierres plates comme les premières. Monte vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur la montagne. Fabrique aussi une arche, c’est-à-dire un coffre en bois.

sw.L: Wakati ule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Jichongee vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, upande kwangu mlimani, ujifanyie sanduku la mbao,
sw.B: Wakati ule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Chonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, upande mlimani unijie; tena ujitengenezee sanduku la mbao,
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliniambia, 'Chonga mawe mawili bapa kama yale ya kwanza. Panda mlimani unijie. Tengeneza pia sanduku, yaani kasha la mbao.

decisions.choice: at that time: after Moses' forty days of prayer for Israel
decisions.reason: "That time" points back to 9:18-29, where Moses lay before the LORD for forty days and nights and pleaded for the people after the golden calf. The story Moses now tells matches Exodus 34:1-4, where the LORD tells him to cut two new tablets.

decisions.choice: an ark of wood: a wooden chest to hold the tablets
decisions.reason: The word for "ark" means a box or chest; the same word is used for Joseph's coffin (Genesis 50:26). Exodus 25:10-22 and 37:1-9 tell how the ark was made with its gold covering. Moses tells it here briefly, as part of his own story, because the point is that the tablets were kept safe.

decisions.choice: Moses is still speaking: the speech that began at 5:1 continues
decisions.reason: The whole chapter lies inside Moses' long speech (5:1-26:19). The LORD's words that Moses repeats are a speech inside his speech.

decisions.choice: no opening quotation mark; the LORD's words in single quotes
decisions.reason: The double quotation mark that opened Moses' speech at 5:1 stays open until 26:19, so this record has none. Words of the LORD that Moses quotes take single quotation marks.

decisions.choice: a wooden ark / an ark, a wooden chest
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "ark", the name this chest has throughout the Law (Exodus 25:10). Because "ark" today suggests Noah's boat, which is a different Hebrew word, Readable explains it once here as a wooden chest.

decisions.choice: "un arca, es decir, un cofre de madera"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "arca", the name of this chest through the Law, and explains it once, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "une arche, c'est-à-dire un coffre en bois"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "arche", the name of this chest through the Law, and explains it once, as the English does; in French "arche" also suggests Noah's boat.

decisions.choice: "sanduku, yaani kasha la mbao"
decisions.reason: "Sanduku" is already the ordinary word for a chest; Readable adds "kasha la mbao" only to mirror the English explanation, so that readers do not take "sanduku" for Noah's "safina".

source.text: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: and I will write on the tablets the words which were on the tablets the first [ones] which you broke, and you will put them in the ark.

en.L: and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.'
en.B: and I will write on these tablets the words that were on the first tablets, the ones you broke. Then put them in the ark.'
en.R: I will write on them the same words that were on the first stones, the ones you broke. Then put the stones in the ark.'

es.L: y escribiré sobre las tablas las palabras que había en las primeras tablas, que quebraste, y las pondrás en el arca”.
es.B: y yo escribiré en estas tablas las palabras que estaban en las primeras, las que rompiste. Luego las pondrás en el arca”.
es.R: Yo escribiré en ellas las mismas palabras que estaban en las primeras piedras, las que rompiste. Después pondrás las piedras en el arca”.

fr.L: et j’écrirai sur les tables les paroles qui étaient sur les premières tables, que tu as brisées, et tu les mettras dans l’arche.”
fr.B: et j’écrirai sur ces tables les paroles qui étaient sur les premières, celles que tu as brisées. Puis tu les mettras dans l’arche.”
fr.R: J’écrirai dessus les mêmes paroles que sur les premières pierres, celles que tu as cassées. Ensuite tu mettras les pierres dans l’arche.”

sw.L: {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaandika juu ya vibao maneno yaliyokuwa juu ya vibao vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja, nawe utaviweka ndani ya sanduku.'
sw.B: {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaandika juu ya vibao hivi maneno yaliyokuwa juu ya vile vya kwanza, ulivyovivunja. Kisha uviweke ndani ya sanduku.'
sw.R: Nitaandika juu yake maneno yale yale yaliyokuwa juu ya mawe ya kwanza, uliyoyavunja. Kisha uyaweke mawe hayo ndani ya sanduku.'

decisions.choice: which you broke: Moses smashed the first tablets when he saw the calf
decisions.reason: Moses told this in 9:17: he threw the tablets down and broke them before the people's eyes (Exodus 32:19). The new tablets carry the very same words; the covenant is renewed, not rewritten.

decisions.choice: I will write: the LORD himself writes the words again
decisions.reason: Moses cuts the stone, but the writing is the LORD's, as with the first tablets (9:10). Verse 4 says that he did so.

decisions.choice: the ark
decisions.reason: As in verse 1: "ark" at every level, explained once in Readable at verse 1.

source.text: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I made an ark of woods of acacia, and I cut two tablets of stones like the first [ones], and I went up the mountain, and the two tablets [were] in my hand.

en.L: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two tablets of stone like the first [ones], and went up the mountain, and the two tablets [were] in my hand.
en.B: So I made an ark of acacia wood, cut two tablets of stone like the first, and climbed the mountain carrying the two tablets.
en.R: So I built the ark from acacia wood. I cut two flat stones like the first ones. Then I carried the two stones up the mountain.

es.L: Hice, pues, un arca de madera de acacia, y labré dos tablas de piedra como las primeras, y subí al monte, y las dos tablas [estaban] en mi mano.
es.B: Así que hice un arca de madera de acacia, labré dos tablas de piedra iguales a las primeras y subí al monte llevando las dos tablas.
es.R: Así que hice el arca de madera de acacia. Corté dos piedras planas como las primeras. Luego subí al monte con las dos piedras.

fr.L: J’ai donc fait une arche de bois d’acacia, et j’ai taillé deux tables de pierre comme les premières, et je suis monté sur la montagne, et les deux tables [étaient] dans ma main.
fr.B: J’ai donc fait une arche en bois d’acacia, j’ai taillé deux tables de pierre semblables aux premières, et je suis monté sur la montagne en portant les deux tables.
fr.R: J’ai donc fabriqué l’arche en bois d’acacia. J’ai taillé deux pierres plates comme les premières. Puis j’ai porté les deux pierres jusqu’en haut de la montagne.

sw.L: Basi nikafanya sanduku la mbao za mshita, nikachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, nikapanda mlimani, na vibao viwili [vilikuwa] mkononi mwangu.
sw.B: Basi nikatengeneza sanduku la mbao za mshita, nikachonga vibao viwili vya mawe kama vile vya kwanza, nikapanda mlimani nikiwa nimebeba vibao hivyo viwili.
sw.R: Basi nilitengeneza sanduku kwa mbao za mshita. Nikachonga mawe mawili bapa kama yale ya kwanza. Kisha nikayabeba mawe hayo mawili hadi juu mlimani.

decisions.choice: acacia: a hard desert tree
decisions.reason: The acacia grows in the dry country of Sinai and the Negev. Its wood is hard and lasts well, and the tabernacle and its furniture were made of it (Exodus 25:10; 26:15).

decisions.choice: I made an ark: told in short, ahead of its place in the story
decisions.reason: Exodus tells of the ark being made after Moses came down (Exodus 37:1). Moses, telling the story years later, puts the ark and the tablets together, because his point is where the tablets were kept. The verb need not mean that he made it before he went up.

decisions.choice: flat stones
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tablets were, flat pieces of stone that could be written on, as in verse 1.

source.text: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל־הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֣וֹם הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he wrote on the tablets like the writing the first, the ten words which spoke Yahweh to you on the mountain from [the] midst of the fire on [the] day of the assembly, and gave them Yahweh to me.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote on the tablets according to the first writing the ten words that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them to me.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wrote on the tablets what had been written before: the Ten Words that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day the assembly gathered. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave them to me.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} wrote on the stones the same words as before. They were the Ten Commandments that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to you from the fire on the mountain, on the day all the people came together. Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave the stones to me.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escribió en las tablas, conforme a la primera escritura, las diez palabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} había hablado en el monte, de en medio del fuego, el día de la asamblea; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me las dio.
es.B: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escribió en las tablas lo mismo que se había escrito antes: las Diez Palabras que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dirigió en el monte desde el fuego, el día en que se reunió la asamblea. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me las entregó.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escribió en las piedras las mismas palabras que antes. Eran los Diez Mandamientos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo desde el fuego en el monte, el día en que todo el pueblo se reunió. Luego {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio las piedras.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écrit sur les tables, selon la première écriture, les dix paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous avait dites sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, le jour de l’assemblée ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me les a données.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écrit sur les tables ce qui y avait été écrit la première fois : les Dix Paroles que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous avait adressées sur la montagne, du milieu du feu, le jour où l’assemblée était réunie. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me les a données.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a écrit sur les pierres les mêmes paroles qu’avant. C’étaient les dix commandements qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous avait dits depuis le feu, sur la montagne, le jour où tout le peuple s’était rassemblé. Ensuite {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné les pierres.

sw.L: Naye akaandika juu ya vibao kama yale maandishi ya kwanza, maneno kumi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema nanyi mlimani kutoka katikati ya moto siku ya kusanyiko; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanipa.
sw.B: Kisha akaandika juu ya vibao yale yaliyokuwa yameandikwa mwanzo: Maneno Kumi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaambia mlimani kutoka katika moto, siku ile kusanyiko lilipokutana. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanipa vibao hivyo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliandika juu ya mawe maneno yale yale kama mwanzo. Yalikuwa Amri Kumi alizowaambia kutoka katika moto juu ya mlima, siku ile watu wote walipokusanyika. Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanipa mawe hayo.

decisions.choice: the ten words: the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: "Word" here means a spoken command, a saying. The ten are the commands God spoke to Israel in 5:6-21 (Exodus 20:1-17), and Moses calls them "ten words" in 4:13 as well.

decisions.choice: the day of the assembly: the day Israel gathered at Horeb
decisions.reason: This is the day all Israel stood at the foot of the mountain and heard God's voice out of the fire (4:10-12; 9:10; 18:16).

decisions.choice: to you: the people Moses speaks to were addressed at Horeb
decisions.reason: Most of the people at Horeb had died in the wilderness (2:14-16). Moses still says the LORD spoke "to you", as in 5:2-4: the covenant made there binds every generation as if each had been present.

decisions.choice: the Ten Words / the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ten words"; Balanced writes "Ten Words" as a name; Readable uses the familiar name, as at Exodus 34:28.

decisions.choice: The LORD wrote
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "he wrote"; Readable names the LORD, since "he" could be taken for Moses.

source.text: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I turned and I came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark which I had made, and they have been there, as commanded me Yahweh.

en.L: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and I put the tablets in the ark that I had made, and they are there, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded me.
en.B: Then I turned and came down from the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made. They are still there, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} commanded me.
en.R: Then I went back down the mountain. I put the stones in the ark I had made, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told me to. They are still in it today.

es.L: Y me volví y bajé del monte, y puse las tablas en el arca que había hecho, y allí están, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mandó.
es.B: Luego me volví, bajé del monte y puse las tablas en el arca que había hecho. Allí siguen, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me lo mandó.
es.R: Después bajé del monte. Puse las piedras en el arca que había hecho, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me había dicho. Todavía hoy están allí.

fr.L: Et je me suis retourné et je suis descendu de la montagne, et j’ai mis les tables dans l’arche que j’avais faite, et elles sont là, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me l’a ordonné.
fr.B: Puis je me suis retourné, je suis descendu de la montagne et j’ai mis les tables dans l’arche que j’avais faite. Elles y sont encore, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me l’avait ordonné.
fr.R: Ensuite je suis redescendu de la montagne. J’ai mis les pierres dans l’arche que j’avais fabriquée, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me l’avait dit. Elles y sont encore aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Nikageuka, nikashuka kutoka mlimani, nikaviweka vibao ndani ya sanduku nililokuwa nimelifanya, navyo vimo humo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoniamuru.
sw.B: Kisha nikageuka, nikashuka kutoka mlimani, nikaviweka vibao ndani ya sanduku nililolitengeneza. Bado vimo humo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoniamuru.
sw.R: Kisha nilishuka kutoka mlimani. Nikayaweka mawe ndani ya sanduku nililolitengeneza, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoniambia. Yamo humo mpaka leo.

decisions.choice: and they are there: they are still in the ark
decisions.reason: The verb "they were" with "there" describes a state that went on from that day to the day Moses speaks. The tablets were still kept in the ark as Israel stood on the plains of Moab (compare 31:26; 1 Kings 8:9).

decisions.choice: still
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "still" to show that the tablets have stayed there up to the time of speaking.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Israel set out from Beeroth Bene-jaakan [to] Moserah; there died Aaron, and he was buried there, and served as priest Eleazar his son in his place.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel set out from Beeroth Bene-jaakan [to] Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried, and Eleazar his son served as priest in his place.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} set out from Beeroth Bene-jaakan for Moserah. There Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became priest in his place.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} traveled from the wells of Bene-jaakan to Moserah. Aaron died there and was buried there. Then his son Eleazar became the priest in his place.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel partieron de Beerot Bene-jaacán [hacia] Moserá. Allí murió Aarón, y allí fue sepultado, y Eleazar su hijo ejerció el sacerdocio en su lugar.
es.B: Los israelitas partieron de Beerot Bene-jaacán hacia Moserá. Allí murió Aarón y allí lo sepultaron, y su hijo Eleazar llegó a ser sacerdote en su lugar.
es.R: Los israelitas viajaron desde los pozos de Bene-jaacán hasta Moserá. Allí murió Aarón y allí lo enterraron. Entonces su hijo Eleazar llegó a ser el sacerdote en su lugar.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël sont partis de Beéroth-Bené-Jaakân [pour] Moséra. Là Aaron est mort, et là il a été enterré, et Éléazar son fils a exercé le sacerdoce à sa place.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont partis de Beéroth-Bené-Jaakân pour Moséra. C’est là qu’Aaron est mort et qu’il a été enterré, et son fils Éléazar est devenu prêtre à sa place.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} sont partis des puits de Bené-Jaakân pour aller à Moséra. Aaron est mort là-bas, et on l’y a enterré. Ensuite son fils Éléazar est devenu prêtre à sa place.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli wakasafiri kutoka Beerothi Bene-yaakani [hadi] Mosera. Huko Haruni akafa, na huko akazikwa, na Eleazari mwanawe akahudumu kama kuhani mahali pake.
sw.B: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka Beerothi Bene-yaakani kwenda Mosera. Huko Haruni alikufa, akazikwa, na mwanawe Eleazari akawa kuhani mahali pake.
sw.R: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka visima vya Bene-yaakani mpaka Mosera. Haruni alikufa huko, akazikwa huko. Kisha mwanawe Eleazari akawa kuhani mahali pake.

decisions.choice: verses 6-9: a note set into Moses' speech
decisions.reason: Moses has been speaking to Israel in the first person ("I", "you"). Here the text speaks of "the sons of Israel" and of Aaron in the third person, a short note about the journey and about the priests and Levites, placed beside the story of the ark. Moses' own words take up again at verse 10. Verses 8-9 may be Moses speaking again, since verse 9 says "your God"; the text has no mark to show where the note ends.

decisions.choice: Beeroth Bene-jaakan, Moserah: camps in the wilderness
decisions.reason: Beeroth Bene-jaakan means "the wells of the sons of Jaakan". Numbers 33:30-33 lists Moseroth, Bene-jaakan, Hor-haggidgad and Jotbathah as camps, in a different order from verses 6-7 here. Neither site is known today.

decisions.choice: there Aaron died: at Moserah
decisions.reason: Numbers 20:22-29 and 33:38 place Aaron's death on Mount Hor. Moserah may be the district in which Mount Hor stood, or the two accounts may describe the same event from different points on the route. The text does not settle which.

decisions.choice: no quotation marks around the note
decisions.reason: The double quotation mark that opened at 5:1 stays open through these verses, because the note sits inside Moses' speech and the speech goes on at verse 10. The note is not given quotation marks of its own.

decisions.choice: the wells of Bene-jaakan
decisions.reason: Readable translates the first part of the name, "Beeroth", which means "wells".

source.text: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן־הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵימָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah [to] Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.

en.L: From there they set out to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah [to] Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.
en.B: From there they set out for Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah for Jotbathah, a land of flowing streams.
en.R: From there they went on to Gudgodah, and then to Jotbathah. There were streams of water in that land.

es.L: De allí partieron hacia Gudgodá, y de Gudgodá [hacia] Jotbata, tierra de arroyos de agua.
es.B: De allí partieron hacia Gudgodá, y de Gudgodá hacia Jotbata, una tierra de arroyos que corren.
es.R: De allí siguieron hasta Gudgodá, y después hasta Jotbata. En aquella tierra había arroyos de agua.

fr.L: De là ils sont partis pour Goudgoda, et de Goudgoda [pour] Jotbatha, un pays de cours d’eau.
fr.B: De là ils sont partis pour Goudgoda, puis de Goudgoda pour Jotbatha, une région où coulent des ruisseaux.
fr.R: De là, ils sont allés à Goudgoda, puis à Jotbatha. Dans cette région, il y avait des ruisseaux.

sw.L: Kutoka huko wakasafiri hadi Gudgoda, na kutoka Gudgoda [hadi] Yotbatha, nchi ya vijito vya maji.
sw.B: Kutoka huko walisafiri kwenda Gudgoda, na kutoka Gudgoda kwenda Yotbatha, nchi yenye vijito vinavyotiririka.
sw.R: Kutoka huko waliendelea mpaka Gudgoda, kisha mpaka Yotbatha. Katika nchi hiyo kulikuwa na vijito vya maji.

decisions.choice: Gudgodah, Jotbathah: camps on the wilderness route
decisions.reason: Gudgodah is probably the Hor-haggidgad of Numbers 33:32-33, and Jotbathah is named in Numbers 33:33-34. Neither site is known today.

decisions.choice: streams of water: valleys with running water
decisions.reason: The word for "stream" names a valley that carries water, often only after rain. In dry country such a place was worth remembering.

source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that set apart Yahweh [the] tribe of the Levi to carry [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh, to stand before Yahweh to serve him and to bless in his name, until the day the this.

en.L: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to bless in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, to this day.
en.B: It was then that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} set the tribe of Levi apart: to carry the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to bless in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. They do so to this day.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chose the tribe of Levi for special work. They were to carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant. They were to stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to bless the people in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. They still do this today.

es.L: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} apartó la tribu de Leví para llevar el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para estar delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para servirle y para bendecir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, hasta este día.
es.B: Fue entonces cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} apartó la tribu de Leví para llevar el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para estar delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y servirle, y para bendecir en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Así lo hacen hasta hoy.
es.R: En aquel tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escogió la tribu de Leví para un trabajo especial. Ellos debían llevar el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Debían estar delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} para servirle, y bendecir al pueblo en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Todavía hoy lo hacen.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis à part la tribu de Lévi pour porter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} afin de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir et de bénir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: C’est alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a mis à part la tribu de Lévi, pour porter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir et bénir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Elle le fait encore aujourd’hui.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a choisi la tribu de Lévi pour un travail spécial. Ses membres devaient porter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils devaient se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir, et bénir le peuple en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Ils le font encore aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Wakati ule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilitenga kabila la Lawi ili kulibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kusimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ili kumtumikia na kubariki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, hata leo.
sw.B: Ilikuwa wakati huo ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilitenga kabila la Lawi, ili walibebe sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wasimame mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia, na kubariki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Wanafanya hivyo mpaka leo.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilichagua kabila la Lawi kwa kazi maalumu. Walipaswa kulibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipaswa kusimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia, na kuwabariki watu kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Mpaka leo bado wanafanya hivyo.

decisions.choice: at that time: in the days at the mountain
decisions.reason: The phrase repeats the start of verse 1 and ties the choosing of Levi to the time of the ark and the tablets at Horeb. Numbers 3:5-13 and 8:5-22 tell how the Levites were set apart for the LORD's service.

decisions.choice: carry the ark, stand before the LORD, serve him, bless in his name: the work of the tribe
decisions.reason: Carrying the ark was the task of Levites (Numbers 4:15; 31:9). Standing before the LORD, serving him and blessing in his name describe priests (18:5; 21:5), who also came from Levi. The blessing is the one given in Numbers 6:23-27.

decisions.choice: the ark of the LORD's covenant
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "ark", which it has already explained in verse 1.

decisions.choice: They do so to this day / They still do this today
decisions.reason: "Until this day" means that the tribe goes on doing this work at the time of writing. Balanced and Readable say so plainly.

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא־הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore not was to Levi a portion and an inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh he [is] his inheritance, as spoke Yahweh your God to him.

en.L: Therefore Levi has no portion or inheritance with his brothers; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is his inheritance, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God spoke to him.
en.B: For this reason Levi has been given no portion of land, no inheritance among his brothers; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is his inheritance, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God promised him.
en.R: That is why the tribe of Levi did not get any land like the other tribes. Instead, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} is their share, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God promised them.

es.L: Por eso Leví no tuvo porción ni heredad con sus hermanos; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es su heredad, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios le dijo.
es.B: Por esta razón Leví no ha recibido porción de tierra ni heredad entre sus hermanos: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es su heredad, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios le prometió.
es.R: Por eso la tribu de Leví no recibió tierra como las otras tribus. En lugar de eso, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo es su parte, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios les prometió.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi Lévi n’a pas eu de part ni d’héritage avec ses frères ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui est son héritage, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu le lui a dit.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi Lévi n’a reçu ni part de terre ni héritage parmi ses frères : c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui est son héritage, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu le lui a promis.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que la tribu de Lévi n’a pas reçu de terre comme les autres tribus. C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}-même qui est leur part, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu le leur a promis.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Lawi hana fungu wala urithi pamoja na ndugu zake; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye urithi wake, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyomwambia.
sw.B: Kwa sababu hiyo Lawi hakupewa fungu la nchi wala urithi kati ya ndugu zake; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye urithi wake, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyomwahidi.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu kabila la Lawi halikupata nchi kama makabila mengine. Badala yake, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} ndiye fungu lao, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alivyowaahidi.

decisions.choice: no portion or inheritance: no share of the land
decisions.reason: When the land was divided, each tribe received its own territory. Levi received none, only towns to live in and the offerings brought to the LORD (18:1-2; Numbers 18:20-24; 35:1-8). "His brothers" are the other tribes.

decisions.choice: the LORD is his inheritance
decisions.reason: Instead of land, Levi has the LORD himself, and lives from what is given to him. The LORD said this to Aaron in Numbers 18:20.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Levi ... their share
decisions.reason: "Levi" here is the tribe, spoken of as one man. Readable says "the tribe of Levi" and uses "their".

source.text: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא־אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, I stayed on the mountain like the days the first, forty days and forty nights; and listened Yahweh to me also at the time the that; not was willing Yahweh to destroy you.

en.L: And I stayed on the mountain, like the first days, forty days and forty nights, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to me that time also; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was not willing to destroy you.
en.B: As before, I remained on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, and this time too {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} heard me; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was not willing to destroy you.
en.R: Once again I stayed on the mountain for forty days and forty nights. And again {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to me. He did not want to destroy you.

es.L: Y yo me quedé en el monte, como los primeros días, cuarenta días y cuarenta noches; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me escuchó también aquella vez; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no quiso destruirte.
es.B: Como la vez anterior, permanecí en el monte cuarenta días y cuarenta noches, y también esta vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me escuchó: no quiso destruirte.
es.R: Una vez más me quedé en el monte cuarenta días y cuarenta noches. Y otra vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me escuchó. No quería destruirte.

fr.L: Et moi, je suis resté sur la montagne, comme les premiers jours, quarante jours et quarante nuits, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a écouté cette fois-là encore ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas voulu te détruire.
fr.B: Comme la première fois, je suis resté sur la montagne quarante jours et quarante nuits, et cette fois encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a exaucé : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas voulu te détruire.
fr.R: Encore une fois, je suis resté sur la montagne quarante jours et quarante nuits. Et de nouveau, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a écouté. Il ne voulait pas te détruire.

sw.L: Nami nilikaa mlimani, kama siku zile za kwanza, siku arobaini na usiku arobaini, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akanisikiliza wakati ule pia; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakutaka kukuangamiza.
sw.B: Kama mara ya kwanza, nilikaa mlimani siku arobaini mchana na usiku, na wakati huo pia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinisikia; hakutaka kukuangamiza.
sw.R: Kwa mara nyingine nilikaa mlimani siku arobaini mchana na usiku. Na tena {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinisikiliza. Hakutaka kukuangamiza.

decisions.choice: like the first days: as on the first time Moses was on the mountain
decisions.reason: Moses spent forty days and nights on the mountain when he first received the tablets (9:9) and again when he prayed for the people (9:18, 25). Here he goes back to his own story after the note of verses 6-9.

decisions.choice: And I: Moses stresses his own part
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is written out, which the verb did not need. It brings the story back to Moses himself, the one who stood between God and the people (5:5).

decisions.choice: the LORD listened ... was not willing to destroy you
decisions.reason: The LORD had said he would destroy Israel (9:14). He heard Moses' prayer and chose not to. The verse closes the story that began in 9:7.

decisions.choice: "destruirte"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is singular here, Israel addressed as one; the Spanish follows the Hebrew number.

decisions.choice: "te détruire"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is singular here, Israel addressed as one; the French follows the Hebrew number, as through Deuteronomy, though the English cannot show it.

decisions.choice: "kukuangamiza"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is singular here, Israel addressed as one; the Swahili follows the Hebrew number.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֨אוּ֙ וְיִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to me, arise, go to journeying before the people, and let them go in and let them take possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Arise, go on the journey before the people, so that they may go in and take possession of the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.'
en.B: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Get up and set out at the head of the people, so that they may go in and take possession of the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.'
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to me, 'Get up and go at the front of the people as they travel. They are to go in and take the land that I promised their ancestors I would give them.'

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Levántate, ve a ponerte en marcha delante del pueblo, para que entren y tomen posesión de la tierra que juré a sus padres que les daría”.
es.B: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Levántate y ponte en camino al frente del pueblo, para que entren y tomen posesión de la tierra que juré a sus antepasados que les daría”.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo: “Levántate y ve al frente del pueblo en su viaje. Ellos deben entrar y tomar la tierra como suya. Es la tierra que prometí a sus antepasados que les daría”.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Lève-toi, va, pour marcher en tête du peuple, et qu’ils entrent et qu’ils prennent possession du pays que j’ai juré à leurs pères de leur donner.”
fr.B: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Lève-toi et mets-toi en route à la tête du peuple, pour qu’ils entrent prendre possession du pays que j’ai juré à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} de leur donner.”
fr.R: Puis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit : “Lève-toi, et marche devant le peuple pendant le voyage. Ils doivent entrer dans le pays et le prendre. C’est le pays que j’ai promis de donner à leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.”

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Inuka, uende safarini mbele ya watu, ili waingie na kuimiliki nchi niliyowaapia baba zao kwamba nitawapa.'
sw.B: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Inuka uanze safari ukiwaongoza watu, ili waingie na kuimiliki nchi niliyowaapia mababu zao kwamba nitawapa.'
sw.R: Kisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaniambia, 'Inuka, uwaongoze watu katika safari yao. Wanapaswa kuingia na kuichukua nchi iwe yao. Ni nchi niliyowaahidi mababu zao kwamba nitawapa.'

decisions.choice: go to journeying before the people: lead the people on the march
decisions.reason: "Before" here means at the head. Moses is told to lead Israel on from Horeb toward the land (1:6-8).

decisions.choice: I swore to their fathers: the oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: The land was promised by oath to Israel's first fathers (1:8; Genesis 22:16-18; 26:3; 28:13). Even after the calf, the LORD holds to that promise.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "fathers"; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors", which is what the word means here: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and those after them.

decisions.choice: the LORD's words in single quotes
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, the LORD's words inside Moses' speech take single quotation marks.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם־לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Israel, what [is] Yahweh your God asking from you, except to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

en.L: And now, Israel, what is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God asking of you, but to fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, to walk in all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways, and to love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and to serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
en.B: And now, Israel, what is it that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God asks of you? Just this: that you fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, follow all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} ways and love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and that you serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
en.R: Now, Israel, what does {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God want from you? He wants you to fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to live the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows you. He wants you to love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart and with all your being.

es.L: Y ahora, Israel, ¿qué te pide {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, sino que temas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, que andes en todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos, y que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ames, y que sirvas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma,
es.B: Y ahora, Israel, ¿qué es lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios espera de ti? Solo esto: que temas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, que sigas todos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} caminos y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ames, y que sirvas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios con todo tu corazón y con toda tu alma,
es.R: Ahora, Israel, ¿qué quiere de ti {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios? Quiere que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temas y que vivas como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te enseña. Quiere que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ames y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sirvas con todo tu corazón y con todo tu ser.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Israël, qu’est-ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te demande, sinon de craindre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, de marcher dans toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} voies, et de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aimer, et de servir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu de tout ton cœur et de toute ton âme,
fr.B: Et maintenant, Israël, qu’attend de toi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ? Simplement ceci : que tu craignes {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, que tu suives tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} chemins et que tu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aimes, que tu serves {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu de tout ton cœur et de toute ton âme,
fr.R: Maintenant, Israël, que veut de toi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu ? Il veut que tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignes et que tu vives comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te le montre. Il veut que tu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aimes et que tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} serves de tout ton cœur et de tout ton être.

sw.L: Na sasa, Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anataka nini kwako, ila kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote, na kumpenda, na kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa nafsi yako yote,
sw.B: Na sasa, Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakutaka nini? Ni hili tu: umche {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, ufuate njia {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote na kumpenda, na umtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote na kwa nafsi yako yote,
sw.R: Sasa, Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anataka nini kwako? Anataka umche na uishi jinsi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anavyokuonyesha. Anataka umpende na umtumikie kwa moyo wako wote na kwa utu wako wote.

decisions.choice: what ... but: a question that answers itself
decisions.reason: "What is the LORD asking of you, but ..." is a question that expects the answer that follows, and it runs on into verse 13. After all the people have done (9:7-10:11), the LORD's demand is put simply.

decisions.choice: fear: reverent awe that leads to obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to take him seriously as God: to honor him, to trust him and to do what he says (4:10; 6:2, 13). It stands here beside love and service, not against them.

decisions.choice: all your heart and all your soul: the whole person
decisions.reason: The heart is the inner self, the mind and will. The soul (Hebrew *nefesh*) is the living self, one's very life. Together they mean with everything one is, as in 6:5.

decisions.choice: Just this:
decisions.reason: Balanced lets the question stand alone and gives its answer after "Just this", which carries the force of "but" ("except").

decisions.choice: live the way he shows you ... your whole self
decisions.reason: Readable explains "walk in his ways" as a way of living, and says "your whole self" for "soul", since many readers take "soul" to mean only the part of a person that lives on after death.

source.text: לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת־מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְט֖וֹב לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: to keep [the] commandments of Yahweh and his statutes which I [am] commanding you the day, for good to you?

en.L: to keep the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes that I am commanding you today, for your good?
en.B: and that you keep the commandments and statutes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that I am giving you today, for your own good.
en.R: He wants you to obey the commands and laws of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that I am giving you today. They are for your good.

es.L: que guardes los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos que yo te mando hoy, para tu bien?
es.B: y que guardes los mandamientos y los estatutos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que hoy te doy, para tu propio bien.
es.R: Quiere que obedezcas los mandamientos y las leyes {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que hoy te doy. Son para tu bien.

fr.L: de garder les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions que je te prescris aujourd’hui, pour ton bien ?
fr.B: et que tu gardes les commandements et les prescriptions {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que je te donne aujourd’hui, pour ton bien.
fr.R: Il veut que tu obéisses aux commandements et aux lois {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que je te donne aujourd’hui. Ils sont pour ton bien.

sw.L: kuzishika amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} ninazokuamuru leo, kwa faida yako?
sw.B: na kuzishika amri na kanuni za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ninazokupa leo, kwa faida yako mwenyewe.
sw.R: Anataka utii amri na sheria za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ninazokupa leo. Ni kwa faida yako.

decisions.choice: commandments and statutes: the whole of the LORD's instruction
decisions.reason: The two words together stand for all that the LORD requires, given through Moses (4:1-2; 6:1-2).

decisions.choice: for your good: the commands serve Israel's life
decisions.reason: The LORD's demands are not a burden laid on Israel for his sake but for theirs, so that it may go well with them (4:40; 5:33; 6:24).

decisions.choice: He wants you to obey
decisions.reason: Readable split the long question of verses 12-13 into statements, so it begins this verse with a new sentence carrying on "He wants you".

source.text: הֵ֚ן לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, to Yahweh your God [belong] the heavens and [the] heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that [is] in it.

en.L: Look, to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [belong] the heavens and the heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that [is] in it.
en.B: See, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God owns the heavens, even the highest heavens, along with the earth and all that it holds.
en.R: Everything belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God: the sky and the heavens above it, all the way up, and the earth and everything on it.

es.L: He aquí, {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios [pertenecen] los cielos y los cielos de los cielos, la tierra y todo lo que [hay] en ella.
es.B: Mira: {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios le pertenecen los cielos, y aun los cielos más altos, junto con la tierra y todo lo que contiene.
es.R: Todo le pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios: el cielo y lo que está encima de él, hasta lo más alto, y la tierra y todo lo que hay en ella.

fr.L: Voici, {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu [appartiennent] les cieux et les cieux des cieux, la terre et tout ce qui [est] en elle.
fr.B: Vois : {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu appartiennent les cieux, et même les plus hauts des cieux, ainsi que la terre et tout ce qu’elle contient.
fr.R: Tout appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu : le ciel, et tout ce qui est au-dessus, jusqu’en haut, et la terre avec tout ce qui s’y trouve.

sw.L: Tazama, mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako [ni] mbingu na mbingu za mbingu, dunia na vyote vilivyomo.
sw.B: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ndiye mwenye mbingu, hata mbingu zilizo juu kabisa, pamoja na dunia na vyote vilivyomo.
sw.R: Kila kitu ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako: anga na mbingu zilizo juu yake, hadi juu kabisa, na dunia na kila kitu kilichomo.

decisions.choice: the heavens of the heavens: the highest heavens
decisions.reason: Repeating a noun this way gives the highest degree, like "holy of holies". All that is above, however far, is the LORD's (1 Kings 8:27; Psalm 148:4).

decisions.choice: the whole world is the LORD's
decisions.reason: This verse sets up the next: the God who owns everything chose Israel's ancestors out of love alone (verse 15; Exodus 19:5).

decisions.choice: Everything belongs to the LORD your God:
decisions.reason: Readable puts the point first and then lists what "everything" includes. It leaves out "Look", whose force the colon carries.

source.text: רַ֧ק בַּאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה לְאַהֲבָ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּבְחַ֞ר בְּזַרְעָ֣ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם בָּכֶ֛ם מִכָּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only on your fathers set his heart Yahweh, to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, you, from all the peoples, as the day the this.

en.L: Yet on your fathers {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} set {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} heart, to love them, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose their offspring after them, you, out of all the peoples, as [it is] this day.
en.B: Even so, it was your ancestors that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was drawn to in love, and after them {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose their offspring, you, from among all the peoples, as is plain today.
en.R: Even so, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love to your ancestors. And out of all the nations {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose you, their children after them, as you can see today.

es.L: Sin embargo, en tus padres puso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} corazón para amarlos, y escogió a su descendencia después de ellos, a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, de entre todos los pueblos, como [se ve] en este día.
es.B: Aun así, fue a tus antepasados a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se apegó con amor, y después de ellos escogió a su descendencia, a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, de entre todos los pueblos, como hoy se ve.
es.R: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor a tus antepasados. Y de entre todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los escogió a ustedes|os escogió a vosotros}}, sus hijos después de ellos, como hoy {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver.

fr.L: Pourtant c’est à tes pères que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est attaché pour les aimer, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi leur descendance après eux, vous, parmi tous les peuples, comme [on le voit] aujourd’hui.
fr.B: Et pourtant, c’est à tes {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est attaché par amour ; et après eux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi leur descendance, vous, parmi tous les peuples, comme on le voit aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Et pourtant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour à tes {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. Et parmi toutes les nations, c’est vous, leurs descendants, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisis, comme vous le voyez aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Ila baba zako ndio {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliowaelekea moyo wake kuwapenda, akauchagua uzao wao baada yao, ninyi, kutoka katika mataifa yote, kama [ilivyo] leo.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, baba zako ndio {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliowavutia kwa upendo, na baada yao akauchagua uzao wao, yaani ninyi, kutoka katika mataifa yote, kama inavyoonekana leo.
sw.R: Hata hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapenda mababu zako. Na kutoka katika mataifa yote aliwachagua ninyi, watoto wao baada yao, kama mnavyoona leo.

decisions.choice: set his heart: was drawn to, loved
decisions.reason: The verb means to be attached to someone, to long for them (21:11; Genesis 34:8). It is used again of God's love for Israel in 7:7.

decisions.choice: only: yet, in spite of this
decisions.reason: The word sets the choice against verse 14. The LORD owns all things, and still he chose these people (7:6-8).

decisions.choice: as this day: as it is now, as you can see
decisions.reason: The phrase points to what is plain at the time of speaking: Israel stands before Moses as the people God chose.

decisions.choice: ancestors ... offspring / children
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers". "Offspring" (literally "seed") stays "offspring" at Balanced and becomes "children" at Readable.

source.text: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעָ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will circumcise [the] foreskin of your heart, and your neck not you will stiffen again.

en.L: So circumcise the foreskin of your heart, and do not stiffen your neck any more.
en.B: Circumcise your hearts, then, and stop stiffening your necks.
en.R: So circumcise your hearts: open them to God. Stop being stubborn.

es.L: {{plural_you:Circunciden|Circuncidad}}, pues, el prepucio de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón, y no {{plural_you:endurezcan|endurezcáis}} más {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cerviz.
es.B: {{plural_you:Circunciden|Circuncidad}}, pues, {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón, y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de endurecer la cerviz.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:circunciden|circuncidad}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón: {{plural_you:ábranlo|abridlo}} a Dios. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de ser tercos.

fr.L: Circoncisez donc le prépuce de votre cœur, et ne raidissez plus votre nuque.
fr.B: Circoncisez donc votre cœur, et cessez de raidir la nuque.
fr.R: Circoncisez donc votre cœur : ouvrez-le à Dieu. Cessez d’être têtus.

sw.L: Basi tahirini govi ya mioyo yenu, wala msizifanye shingo zenu kuwa ngumu tena.
sw.B: Basi tahirini mioyo yenu, na acheni kuzifanya shingo zenu kuwa ngumu.
sw.R: Basi tahirini mioyo yenu: ifungueni kwa Mungu. Acheni ukaidi.

decisions.choice: circumcise the foreskin of your heart: remove what closes the heart to God
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of the covenant on the body (Genesis 17:10-14). An "uncircumcised" heart is closed and unwilling to hear (Leviticus 26:41; Jeremiah 4:4; 9:25). The command is to open oneself fully to the LORD, so that the inward life matches the outward sign. In 30:6 the LORD promises that he himself will circumcise their hearts.

decisions.choice: stiffen your neck: be stubborn
decisions.reason: The picture is an ox that stiffens its neck and will not take the yoke. Moses has called Israel "a stiff-necked people" (9:6, 13).

decisions.choice: you will circumcise: a command
decisions.reason: The verb form, joined to what comes before, gives an order that follows from verses 14-15: since the LORD loved and chose you, respond to him.

decisions.choice: circumcise your hearts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out "foreskin", since "circumcise your hearts" already carries the picture. Literal keeps the full wording.

decisions.choice: open them to God ... Stop being stubborn
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture and adds what it means, and says the meaning of "stiffen your neck" without the picture.

source.text: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד׃

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh your God, he [is] God of the gods and Lord of the lords, the God the great, the mighty and the awesome, who not lifts up face and not takes a bribe,

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty and the awesome, who does not lift up a face and does not take a bribe,
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is God over all gods and Lord over all lords. He is the great God, mighty and awe-inspiring, who plays no favorites and cannot be moved by a bribe.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is greater than every god and every lord. He is the great God. He is strong, and people should stand in awe of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He treats everyone the same, and no one can pay {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to change what is right.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es Dios de dioses y Señor de señores, el Dios grande, poderoso y temible, que no alza el rostro [de nadie] ni acepta soborno,
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} es Dios por encima de todos los dioses y Señor por encima de todos los señores. Es el gran Dios, poderoso e imponente, que no favorece a nadie y no se deja comprar con sobornos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} es más grande que todos los dioses y todos los señores. Es el gran Dios. Es fuerte, y la gente debe temblar de respeto ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Trata a todos por igual, y nadie puede pagarle para que cambie lo que es justo.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} le Dieu des dieux et le Seigneur des seigneurs, le Dieu grand, puissant et redoutable, qui ne relève la face de personne et ne prend pas de pot-de-vin,
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tous les dieux et le Seigneur au-dessus de tous les seigneurs. C’est le grand Dieu, puissant et redoutable, qui ne fait pas de favoritisme et qu’aucun pot-de-vin ne peut acheter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est plus grand que tous les dieux et tous les seigneurs. C’est le grand Dieu. Il est fort, et on doit trembler de respect devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il traite tout le monde de la même façon, et personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} payer pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} faire changer ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni Mungu wa miungu na Bwana wa mabwana, Mungu mkuu, mwenye nguvu na wa kutisha, asiyeinua uso [wa mtu] wala hapokei rushwa,
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ni Mungu juu ya miungu yote na Bwana juu ya mabwana wote. Yeye ni Mungu mkuu, mwenye nguvu na wa kuogofya, asiyempendelea mtu yeyote wala hashawishiki kwa rushwa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ni mkuu kuliko kila mungu na kila bwana. Yeye ni Mungu mkuu. Ana nguvu, na watu wanapaswa kumcha kwa hofu kuu. Huwatendea watu wote sawa, na hakuna awezaye kumlipa ili abadilishe yaliyo haki.

decisions.choice: God of gods and Lord of lords: the highest God, over every power
decisions.reason: Joining a noun to its own plural gives the highest degree, as in verse 14. Whatever beings or powers are called gods or lords, the LORD stands above them all (Psalm 136:2-3).

decisions.choice: awesome: one to be feared
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "to fear" (verse 12). God is "awesome" because his power and holiness bring people to awe and dread (7:21).

decisions.choice: lift up a face: show favor to someone
decisions.reason: To lift a person's face was to accept them, to treat them with favor. A judge who did it for the powerful was unjust (1:17; 16:19). God does not.

decisions.choice: lift up a face
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture, explained in the note; Balanced and Readable give its sense.

decisions.choice: "que no alza el rostro [de nadie]"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of lifting a face (showing favour), as the English Literal does. Balanced says "no favorece a nadie".

decisions.choice: "qui ne relève la face de personne"
alternatives: "qui ne fait pas acception de personnes"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of lifting a face (showing favour), as the English Literal does; the traditional "faire acception de personnes" gives the sense but not the picture. Balanced says "ne fait pas de favoritisme".

decisions.choice: "asiyeinua uso [wa mtu]"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of lifting a face (showing favour). Balanced says "asiyempendelea mtu yeyote".

source.text: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: doing justice [for the] fatherless and widow, and loving [the] sojourner, to give to him food and clothing.

en.L: executing justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loving the sojourner, giving him food and clothing.
en.B: He sees that orphans and widows get justice, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} loves the outsider living among you and gives them food and clothing.
en.R: He makes sure that children without fathers and women without husbands are treated fairly. He loves outsiders who live among you, and gives them food and clothes.

es.L: que hace justicia al huérfano y a la viuda, y ama al inmigrante, dándole pan y vestido.
es.B: Hace justicia al huérfano y a la viuda, y ama al extranjero que vive entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y le da comida y ropa.
es.R: Se asegura de que los niños sin padre y las mujeres sin marido sean tratados con justicia. Ama a los extranjeros que viven entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y les da comida y ropa.

fr.L: qui fait justice à l’orphelin et à la veuve, et qui aime l’immigré, pour lui donner du pain et un vêtement.
fr.B: Il fait droit à l’orphelin et à la veuve, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime l’étranger qui vit parmi vous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui donne nourriture et vêtements.
fr.R: Il veille à ce que les enfants sans père et les femmes sans mari soient traités avec justice. Il aime les étrangers qui vivent parmi vous, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne de quoi manger et s’habiller.

sw.L: anayewafanyia haki yatima na mjane, na kumpenda mgeni, akimpa chakula na mavazi.
sw.B: Huhakikisha kwamba yatima na wajane wanapata haki, naye humpenda mgeni anayeishi kati yenu, akimpa chakula na mavazi.
sw.R: Huhakikisha kwamba watoto wasio na baba na wanawake wasio na waume wanatendewa haki. Huwapenda wageni wanaoishi kati yenu, na huwapa chakula na nguo.

decisions.choice: the fatherless, the widow, the sojourner: people without protection
decisions.reason: In Israel land and protection came through the family. A child without a father, a woman without a husband and an outsider without land had no one to stand up for them (24:17-21; Exodus 22:20-23). The God above all gods is the one who takes their side.

decisions.choice: doing justice: securing what is right for them
decisions.reason: "Justice" here is the fair judgment and the rights that belong to someone; God sees that the weak receive them.

decisions.choice: food: literally "bread"
decisions.reason: "Bread" often stands for food in general.

decisions.choice: He sees that ... / He makes sure that
decisions.reason: The Hebrew continues the description of God from verse 17 with "doing" and "loving". Balanced and Readable start a new sentence with "He".

decisions.choice: the outsider living among you / outsiders who live among you ... them
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sojourner" and "him". Balanced and Readable say what a sojourner was, as in Leviticus 19:33-34, and use "them", since any outsider, man or woman, is meant.

source.text: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will love the sojourner, for sojourners you were in [the] land of Egypt.

en.L: And you shall love the sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.
en.B: You too must love the outsider, since you were outsiders yourselves in the land of Egypt.
en.R: So you must love outsiders too. Remember that you were once outsiders in the land of Egypt.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:amarán|amaréis}} al inmigrante, porque inmigrantes {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} en la tierra de Egipto.
es.B: También {{plural_you:ustedes deben|vosotros debéis}} amar al extranjero, ya que {{plural_you:ustedes mismos fueron|vosotros mismos fuisteis}} extranjeros en la tierra de Egipto.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:ustedes también deben|vosotros también debéis}} amar a los extranjeros. {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} extranjeros en Egipto.

fr.L: Et vous aimerez l’immigré, car vous avez été des immigrés au pays d’Égypte.
fr.B: Vous aussi, vous devez aimer l’étranger, puisque vous avez vous-mêmes été des étrangers au pays d’Égypte.
fr.R: Vous devez donc aimer les étrangers, vous aussi. Souvenez-vous que vous avez été autrefois des étrangers en Égypte.

sw.L: Nanyi mtampenda mgeni, kwa maana mlikuwa wageni katika nchi ya Misri.
sw.B: Ninyi pia mnapaswa kumpenda mgeni, kwa kuwa ninyi wenyewe mlikuwa wageni katika nchi ya Misri.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo ninyi pia lazima muwapende wageni. Kumbukeni kwamba nanyi mlikuwa wageni katika nchi ya Misri zamani.

decisions.choice: you will love the sojourner: Israel must do what God does
decisions.reason: Verse 18 said that God loves the outsider; now Israel is told to love the outsider too. Leviticus 19:34 gives the same command.

decisions.choice: you were sojourners in Egypt: Israel's own past
decisions.reason: Israel lived in Egypt as outsiders and was oppressed there (Exodus 1:11-14; 22:20; 23:9). Remembering it, they are to treat outsiders well.

decisions.choice: you too
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "too" to show the link with verse 18: as God loves the outsider, so must Israel.

decisions.choice: outsider
decisions.reason: As in verse 18 and Leviticus 19:34, Balanced says "outsider" and Readable "outsider" for the sojourner.

source.text: אֶת־יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh your God you will fear; him you will serve, and to him you will cling, and by his name you will swear.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God you shall fear; {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you shall serve, and to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you shall hold fast, and by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name you shall swear.
en.B: It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God you must fear and serve; hold fast to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and swear your oaths by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.
en.R: Fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and no other, and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Stay close to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. When you make a promise, make it in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name.

es.L: {{divine_name:Al SEÑOR|A Yahvé}} tu Dios temerás; a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} servirás, y a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te aferrarás, y por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre jurarás.
es.B: Es {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios a quien debes temer y servir; mantente unido a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y haz tus juramentos en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.
es.R: Teme {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y a ningún otro, y sírvele. Mantente cerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Cuando hagas una promesa, hazla en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre.

fr.L: C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu que tu craindras ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que tu serviras, à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que tu t’attacheras, et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom que tu prêteras serment.
fr.B: C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu que tu dois craindre et servir ; reste attaché à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et fais tes serments en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.
fr.R: Crains {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et aucun autre, et sers-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. Reste tout près de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Quand tu fais une promesse, fais-la en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako utamcha; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} utamtumikia, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} utaambatana naye, na kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} utaapa.
sw.B: Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako unayepaswa kumcha na kumtumikia; shikamana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, na uape kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: Mche {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, wala si mwingine, umtumikie. Kaa karibu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Unapoahidi kwa kiapo, uape kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

decisions.choice: the LORD ... him ... to him ... by his name: placed first for stress
decisions.reason: Each clause puts the LORD before its verb. The order stresses that it is he, and no other god, whom Israel must fear, serve, cling to and swear by (6:13-14).

decisions.choice: hold fast: cling, stay joined
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a man joined to his wife (Genesis 2:24) and of Ruth clinging to Naomi (Ruth 1:14). It means close, lasting loyalty (11:22; 13:5).

decisions.choice: swear by his name: take oaths in the LORD's name
decisions.reason: An oath called on a god as witness and judge. To swear by the LORD's name is to acknowledge him alone as God.

decisions.choice: and no other
decisions.reason: Readable puts into words the stress the Hebrew word order gives (see the first note).

source.text: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת־הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַנּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: He [is] your praise, and he [is] your God, who did with you the great [things] and the awesome [things] these which have seen your eyes.

en.L: He is your praise, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things that your eyes have seen.
en.B: He is the one you praise and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is your God. You have seen with your own eyes the great and awe-inspiring deeds {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for you.
en.R: He is the one you should praise. He is your God. You have seen with your own eyes the great and amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done for you.

es.L: Él es tu alabanza, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es tu Dios, que ha hecho contigo estas cosas grandes y temibles que han visto tus ojos.
es.B: Él es a quien alabas y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es tu Dios. Con tus propios ojos has visto los hechos grandes e imponentes que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho por ti.
es.R: Él es a quien debes alabar. Él es tu Dios. Con tus propios ojos has visto las cosas grandes y asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho por ti.

fr.L: Il est ta louange, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est ton Dieu, qui a fait pour toi ces choses grandes et redoutables que tes yeux ont vues.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que tu dois louer, et c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ton Dieu. Tu as vu de tes propres yeux les actes grands et redoutables qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accomplis pour toi.
fr.R: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que tu dois louer. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ton Dieu. Tu as vu de tes propres yeux les choses grandes et extraordinaires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites pour toi.

sw.L: Yeye ndiye sifa yako, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wako, aliyekutendea mambo haya makuu na ya kutisha, ambayo macho yako yameyaona.
sw.B: Yeye ndiye unayemsifu, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wako. Umeona kwa macho yako mwenyewe matendo makuu na ya kuogofya aliyokutendea.
sw.R: Yeye ndiye unayepaswa kumsifu. Yeye ndiye Mungu wako. Umeona kwa macho yako mwenyewe mambo makuu na ya ajabu aliyokutendea.

decisions.choice: your praise: the one you praise
alternatives: your pride, the one who brings you renown
decisions.reason: The phrase means that the LORD is the one whom Israel praises. It may also mean that he is Israel's pride, the source of its fame among the nations (26:19; Jeremiah 17:14).

decisions.choice: these great and awesome things: the rescue from Egypt and the wilderness
decisions.reason: The great deeds are the plagues, the crossing of the sea and the care in the wilderness that the people saw for themselves (4:34; 7:19; 11:2-7).

decisions.choice: with your own eyes
decisions.reason: "Your eyes have seen" stresses that the people saw it themselves; Balanced and Readable say "with your own eyes".

source.text: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָהּוְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: With seventy persons went down your fathers to Egypt, and now has made you Yahweh your God like [the] stars of the heavens for multitude.

en.L: With seventy persons your fathers went down to Egypt, and now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has made you like the stars of the heavens for multitude.
en.B: Your ancestors were seventy persons when they went down to Egypt, and now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has made you like the stars of the heavens, past counting.
en.R: When your ancestors went down to Egypt, there were only seventy of them. Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has made you as many as the stars in the sky.

es.L: Con setenta personas descendieron tus padres a Egipto, y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha hecho como las estrellas de los cielos en multitud.
es.B: Tus antepasados eran setenta personas cuando bajaron a Egipto, y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha hecho tan numeroso como las estrellas del cielo, imposible de contar.
es.R: Cuando tus antepasados bajaron a Egipto, eran solo setenta. Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te ha hecho tan numeroso como las estrellas del cielo.

fr.L: Avec soixante-dix personnes tes pères sont descendus en Égypte, et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a fait de toi [un peuple] comme les étoiles du ciel, en multitude.
fr.B: Tes {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} étaient soixante-dix personnes quand ils sont descendus en Égypte, et maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a rendu aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel, impossible à compter.
fr.R: Quand tes {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} sont descendus en Égypte, ils n’étaient que soixante-dix. Maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a rendu aussi nombreux que les étoiles du ciel.

sw.L: Baba zako walishuka Misri wakiwa watu sabini, na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekufanya kama nyota za mbinguni kwa wingi.
sw.B: Mababu zako walikuwa watu sabini walipotelemka Misri, na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekufanya mwingi kama nyota za mbinguni, usiyeweza kuhesabika.
sw.R: Mababu zako waliposhuka Misri, walikuwa watu sabini tu. Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako amekufanya kuwa wengi kama nyota za angani.

decisions.choice: seventy persons: Jacob's family when it went down to Egypt
decisions.reason: Genesis 46:27 and Exodus 1:5 count Jacob's household that came to Egypt as seventy.

decisions.choice: like the stars of the heavens: the promise to Abraham kept
decisions.reason: The LORD promised Abraham that his offspring would be as many as the stars (Genesis 15:5; 22:17). Moses has already said that this has come true (1:10).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.

decisions.choice: only
decisions.reason: Readable adds "only" to bring out the contrast between seventy people and a nation too many to count.
